messages.subject: Can you use ggplot2 (qplot) to generate the plot?
parts:
Can I use ggplot inside a reactivePlot(function() {}?

I've had success with plot, hist, boxplot but I'd like to use qplot mainly because I'd like to manipulate the layout.

Thanks

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Can you use ggplot2 (qplot) to generate the plot?
parts: Yes. I think you may have to explicitly call print() within the reactivePlot, but it should work. See https://gist.github.com/3239667
